places.title: Joy & Southfield
places.blurb: Being researched. In 1949 this ground is open and disturbed — a large flat-roofed building, spoil heaps and what looks like an excavation — while the streets south of it are already built solid. By 1961 a large institution stands here with a playfield to the north.
